name: Question
about: Ask a question about using the dashboard or Stellar.
title: "[QUESTION] "
labels: question
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        Ask your question below, and provide any context that will help us answer it.
  - type: textarea
    id: question
    attributes:
      label: Question
      description: What would you like to know?
  - type: textarea
    id: context
    attributes:
      label: Context
      description: Any relevant details about your use case or environment.
